description.value: Guu Davie is a lively Japanese izakaya on Vancouver's Davie Street, part of the Guu group that pioneered izakaya dining in Canada. Opened in February 2019, it specializes in authentic nabemono hot pots — Shabu Shabu and Oden — alongside izakaya staples like karaage and freshly cut sashimi. The restaurant is known for its energetic, shouting-greeting atmosphere and is part of a multi-location chain with roots going back to 2000.
